chars.MOM: MOM: a pretty Moroccan woman in her early thirties, long wavy dark-brown hair loose, wearing a fitted mustard-yellow cardigan over a white top, light-blue jeans, small gold hoop earrings
chars.SON: SON: a skinny Moroccan teenage boy of 14, short curly black hair, wearing a bright red hoodie with a white stripe on the sleeves, black joggers, white sneakers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Cozy Moroccan apartment living room in Casablanca with a traditional salon sofa. MOM sits on the sofa secretly smiling and typing on her phone, shielding the screen, head-to-waist framing, face clearly visible. SON peeks at her from a half-open doorway in the foreground edge, suspicious frown. Comic, curious mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment hallway, closed bathroom door with light underneath and steam. SON tiptoes away holding his mother's phone in both hands, looking back nervously at the door, sneaky expression. Head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of SON sitting on the edge of a bed in a modest Moroccan bedroom, eagerly scrolling his mother's smartphone (screen faces away from viewer), eyebrows raised, focused.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SON in a Moroccan bedroom staring at a phone in shock, mouth wide open, eyes huge, one hand on his head, the phone glow lighting his face. Screen faces away from the viewer. Comic shocked expression.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SON alone in his small Moroccan bedroom, angry and upset, hitting his fist against the wall, frustrated face, posters on the wall, evening light. Medium shot, not violent, just frustrated.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment at night. MOM in the kitchen leaning on the counter, giggling while texting on her phone. SON watches her secretly from the hallway corner in the foreground, suspicious squint. Both faces visible.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Front door of a Moroccan apartment, afternoon. MOM all dressed up with lipstick and a small handbag, opening the door to leave, waving casually. SON stands in the hallway with crossed arms, staring at her with doubt.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Busy Casablanca street with white apartment buildings and palm trees. In the middle ground MOM gets into a small red petit taxi. In the foreground SON hides behind a parked car, peeking, hood up, determined face.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the back seat of a red Moroccan petit taxi, SON leans forward pointing ahead, looking intently through the windshield at a modern café terrace with umbrellas down the street. Tense comic expression.
